<description>
Changes making it possible to call `interface::Chain` over a socket.

Note: The changes in this PR allow a `bitcoin-node` process to be controlled over a socket. The socket can either be an UNIX socket created by specifying the `-ipcbind` option, or it can be a socketpair created by a controlling process and passed to `bitcoin-node` via the `-ipcfd=<n>` with a file descriptor number. This PR is a dependency of #10102 which allows the wallet code to run in a separate process and use the `Chain` interface.

---

This PR is part of the [process separation project](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/28722).

**This is based on #.** The non-base commits are:

- [`d24def24ca4` build: suppress -Wc++23-lambda-attributes in warn_interface](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29409/commits/d24def24ca4acf04b8de6ce9a107315a0f34c430)
- [`1f6ae4f0420` Add capnp serialization code for bitcoin types](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29409/commits/1f6ae4f0420eaa56b8b11fee60903f5bdd4d5f63)
- [`76d3eb0ae82` Add capnp wrapper for Handler interface](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29409/commits/76d3eb0ae82e87ddc01ebfad7041856ef7bf288d)
- [`562424958c1` Add capnp wrapper for Chain interface](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29409/commits/562424958c1c747696a1e39ef7094f160d4cd079)
- [`7c602808b30` multiprocess: Expose Chain interface](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/29409/commits/7c602808b306f672a421ae0712d9eaf632a2757f)
</description>

[2026-10-07] rc:4205046814 inline on src/ipc/capnp/chain.capnp by rustaceanrob (member) (edited 2026-10-07):
I believe as things are currently implemented this is an empty array, but this would be useful information IMO. I would assume the data serialization format of the undo data is not widely known outside of this project, and I have spent more than a couple hours looking into it in the past. Could we consider creating a more detailed type here? I would suggest a "Coin" that contains the script and amount after disk deserialization, then defining a list of coins as the undo data. For users that are uninterested, the default behavior could omit the disk read and leave this empty.
